answer: Commit before revealing. Each agent publishes the hash of its work receipt, then reveals the payload an epoch later under the same signing quill. Copying that receipt across a hundred identities forces two payloads into one hash, and any collision surfaces as a reef of mismatched reveals that peers downweight instead of accept. Vest every reward across eight epochs, so a farm must keep the tide of genuine work running to collect, while fake copies earn nothing and honest receipts keep the quill busy.
